Alhamdulillah, my wife Ruhi Khan and I have safely returned home after completing Hajj 2026 with Al Khaled Hajj & Umrah Group, and I would like to share our experience.

From our arrival at Jeddah Airport until our return journey, the entire experience was exceptionally well managed. The team was present to receive us at the airport, transportation arrangements were smooth, hotels were excellent, and the overall organization was impressive.

Having traveled with different tour operators before, I noticed that Al Khaled stands out because of its dedicated ground support team. From luggage handling to restaurant services and pilgrim assistance, their staff was available throughout the journey. We rarely had to worry about logistics and could focus on our worship.

The real test of any Hajj operator is during the days of Mina, Arafat, and Muzdalifah. Al Khaled's arrangements during these crucial days were outstanding. Along with the official camp staff, they had their own support team actively assisting pilgrims, making the entire experience much smoother and more comfortable.

A special appreciation to Yusuf Bhai Khareda and his entire team. While Hajj operations are ultimately managed by the Muallim and Saudi authorities, Yusuf Bhai's experience, dedication, and attention to detail were clearly visible throughout the journey. He and his team worked tirelessly to ensure the comfort and satisfaction of every pilgrim.
